name: chunk_id
description: Unique chunk identifier (e.g., NVDA_2026_item_1a_0001)

name: profile_id
description: Foreign key to financial_metrics.profile_id ({TICKER}_{FY})

name: ticker
description: Canonical SEC EDGAR company ticker symbol

name: cik
description: 10-digit zero-padded SEC Central Index Key

name: company_name
description: Official SEC registrant name

name: gics_sector
description: GICS Sector classification for metadata-filtered RAG

name: gics_sub_industry
description: GICS Sub-Industry classification

name: form_type
description: SEC form type (10-K)

name: fiscal_year
description: Reporting fiscal year for longitudinal RAG filtering

name: period_of_report
description: Fiscal period end date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: filing_date
description: SEC EDGAR filing submission date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: accession_number
description: SEC EDGAR accession number

name: section_id
description: Normalized 10-K section identifier (item_1a or item_7)

name: section_title
description: Human-readable section heading for grounded UI citations

name: chunk_index
description: 0-based sequential chunk index within the section

name: chunk_text
description: Markdown passage text for RAG synthesis and grounding

name: char_count
description: Character length of chunk_text

name: token_estimate
description: Approximate token count of chunk_text

name: embedding
description: Dense vector embedding (ARRAY<FLOAT64>) for BigQuery VECTOR_SEARCH

name: embedding_model
description: Vertex AI embedding model identifier (e.g., text-embedding-005, gemini-embedding-001)

name: unstructured_gcs_uri
description: GCS URI of the parent unstructured 10-K Markdown document

name: structured_gcs_uri
description: GCS URI of the paired structured financial metrics JSON

name: sec_filing_url
description: Direct SEC EDGAR archive URL for split-pane citation viewing

name: ingested_at
description: UTC timestamp when the chunk and embedding were indexed
